name: Adding and removing a load re-solves the schedule

planSteps.description: Open the app, wait for the initial solve, and note the saving figure and the EV charger's slot count.
Verify a fourth load row appears and the saving figure or slot counts change, proving the schedule was recomputed rather than left stale.
Remove the new load with its 'x' button.
Verify the row disappears and the figures return to their previous values.
